match.userMessage:
Use Image 1 as the starting frame.
Shot 1: Smooth handheld drift closer over Image 2’s shoulder as she continues opening the coral lipstick package from her current pose. She keeps her attention on the lipstick and ignores the vibrating phone beside the faucet. Cut to Shot 2: Gradual macro push-in as Image 2 twists the lipstick upward and rotates it between her fingers through the hard stripe of sunlight, steadying the tube with her other hand. Cut to Shot 3: Static lock-off on Image 2’s mirror reflection as she applies the lipstick, pauses at a distant rumble, then checks the phone and reaches for her sunglasses. She gives her reflection a small knowing smile, speaks softly, and exits the reflection, leaving the coral lipstick momentarily prominent.

Image 2 says in a soft self-possessed tone: <d>[English] Okay. City’s waiting.</d>

overall_soundscape: quiet bathroom ambience with faint city noise and a distant subway rumble. phone vibrating beside the faucet, carton tearing, soft lipstick tube twist, phone tap, sunglasses picked up, light footsteps exiting. No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

subject_definitions:

<Subject 2> is the coral lipstick package and tube being opened and applied, matching the visible product in <Picture 1>.
<Subject 3> is the white-tiled bathroom environment with a black marble counter, chrome faucet, smartphone, and wall-mounted mirror, as defined in <Picture 1>.
<Picture 1> is the starting keyframe setting the exact scene layout, lighting, and pose.
<Picture 2> is the appearance reference for <Subject 1>.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video begins on the keyframe <Picture 1> and develops a 6-second continuity of <Subject 1> opening <Subject 2> and applying it in <Subject 3>, ending on her mirror reflection as she departs.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - identity, hair, facial features, black turtleneck, grey trousers, and bracelet remain the same throughout.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - coral package color, shape, and tube mechanics carry continuously from opening to application.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - bathroom geometry, marble counter, faucet, mirror, and morning sunlight are consistent.
<Picture 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - opening frame matches the keyframe exactly in composition, lighting, and pose.
<Picture 2> (drives <Subject 1> throughout [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): attribute_transfer - facial likeness, hair tone, and outfit used as appearance reference.

detailed_description:
Cinematic realistic style with soft natural window light, shallow depth of field, and muted bathroom tones. The sequence opens exactly on the keyframe: <Subject 1> stands in profile before the <Subject 3> mirror, hands holding <Subject 2> over the black marble counter while the smartphone vibrates on the counter beside the faucet.

[Shot 1] The frame matches <Picture 1> precisely. The camera performs a handheld Tracking Shot drifting closer over <Subject 1>’s shoulder with small amplitude at a slow speed. <Subject 1> keeps her eyes locked on <Subject 2>, sliding the coral outer sleeve off and beginning to open the carton, her attention ignoring the buzzing phone nearby. A faint carton-tear sound plays.

At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to the close-up.

[Shot 2] A slow macro Push In at slow amplitude moves toward <Subject 2> as <Subject 1> twists the tube upward, rotating the compact between her fingers through a hard diagonal stripe of sunlight while her other hand steadies the base. The metallic click of the twist is audible.

At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to the mirror.

[Shot 3] A Static Lock-off frames <Subject 1>’s reflection in the bathroom mirror applying the coral lipstick, face matched to <Picture 2>. She pauses at an audible distant railway rumble, glances off, taps the vibrating phone to stop it, and reaches down toward her sunglasses off-frame. <Subject 1> (S1) gives her reflection a small knowing smile and speaks softly: <d>[English] Okay. City’s waiting.</d> She walks out of the mirror’s field, and the lingering empty mirror keeps the coral <Subject 2> visibly prominent on the counter.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet bathroom ambience with faint distant city traffic and a low subway rumble. Diegetic action sounds include a short phone vibration, paper carton tearing, a soft metal twist click, a phone tap, the lift of sunglasses, and light footsteps exiting. No non-diegetic layers.
